company_name: Ningbo Baosi Energy Equipment Co., Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — the company specializes in vacuum systems and components, which are critical in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Ningbo Baosi Energy Equipment Co., Ltd. designs, manufactures, and sells vacuum products, focusing on high-end precision parts and integrated systems. Their Vacuum Division provides one-stop vacuum solutions, aiming to establish a strong brand presence in the global market.

regional_presence.China: The company is headquartered in Fenghua, China, and has established a significant presence in the vacuum equipment market.
